task.title: P6-161: Ensure the tray's aria-live count announces the first pick
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Accessibility). Original id: P6-161. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**The tray's `aria-live="polite"` count enters the DOM together with its first content, so the first pick is typically never announced** (was `P6-046f`; the whole tray is inside `<Show>`, `selection_tray.rs:275-290`) — only later changes are.
